name: Exemplary Student Research Program (ESRP)
what_you_do: A school-year research project with an Argonne scientist mentor. A team of 4 to 8 students from one school writes a proposal, collects data at an Argonne lab, and presents a poster in the spring.
grades: High school students in honors or AP science classes
who_can_apply: High school students picked by a science teacher at their school. The teacher must hold a grades 9 to 12 teaching license. One team per school.
pay_detail: No cost or pay is stated on the page.
duration: One school year, with two required trips to Argonne
deadline_text: Teachers registered for the 2026-27 school year by June 30, 2026. The 2027-28 date is not posted.
how_to_apply: Students cannot apply on their own. Ask a science teacher to apply for a team. The teacher goes to an August workshop, gets a scientist mentor and picks the students.
notes: Share this page with a science teacher in the spring. Teams become official Argonne facility users. Argonne's College Bound and Bridge into Internships programs need you to be 18, so they are not listed.
